title: Optics III
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used extensively in medicine and engineering."
Fibrescopes are used extensively in medicine and engineering.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique of three-dimensional photography."
Holography is a technique of three-dimensional photography.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the light wave falling directly on the photosensitive plate."
Reference wave is the light wave falling directly on the photosensitive plate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a double exposure, with the second pattern of wave fronts superposed on the first."
The hologram thus obtained is a double exposure, with the second pattern of wave fronts superposed on the first.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an acronym for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation."
The name laser is an acronym for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuum of superposed zone plates- an unrecognisable multiplicity of lines and rings."
The intermediate recording is a continuum of superposed zone plates- an unrecognisable multiplicity of lines and rings.
fib: ______ is the converse process of emission.
Absorption of light is the converse process of emission.
______ is used up in the excitation of atoms to higher energy states.
The lost energy is used up in the excitation of atoms to higher energy states.
______ refers to the correlation between the phases of two light waves travelling side by side.
Spatial coherence or transverse spatial coherence refers to the correlation between the phases of two light waves travelling side by side.
______ is known as LIDAR (light detection and ranging) and its operations are similar to those of a radar.
The technique is known as LIDAR (light detection and ranging) and its operations are similar to those of a radar.
______ is a distinct improvement over normal interferometry because the former can be used for any kind of material.
Holographic interferometry is a distinct improvement over normal interferometry because the former can be used for any kind of material.
